lines: Ab bulandi pe tera sitara nahin
couplets.en: Your star no longer stands high.

lines: Ghair ka zikr kya, ghair phir ghair hai, jo hamara tha woh bhi hamara nahin
couplets.en: Why speak of strangers when even what was ours has slipped away?

lines: Ae mere hamnasheen, chal kaheen aur chal
couplets.en: Come, my companion, let us go elsewhere.

lines: Is chaman mein ab apna guzara nahin
couplets.en: We can no longer stay in this garden.

couplets.en: We can no longer stay in this garden.

lines: Baat hoti gulon tak to seh lete hum
couplets.en: Had it been only the flowers, we could have borne it.

lines: Ab to kaanton pe bhi haq hamara nahin
couplets.en: Now even the thorns are denied us.

lines: Ae mere hamnasheen
couplets.en: Oh, my companion.

lines: Di sada daar par, aur kabhi Toor par
couplets.en: I called from the gallows and from Mount Sinai.

lines: Kis jagah maine tumko pukara nahin?
couplets.en: Where have I not called to you?

lines: Di sada daar par, aur kabhi Toor par

lines: Kis jagah maine tumko pukara nahin?
couplets.en: Where have I not called to you?

lines: Thokrein yun khilane se kya faida?
couplets.en: What good is there in turning me away like this?

lines: Saaf keh do ke milna gawara nahin
couplets.en: Say plainly that you cannot bear to see me.

lines: Gulistan ko lahu ki zaroorat padi
couplets.en: The garden needed blood.

lines: Sab se pehle hi gardan hamari kati
couplets.en: Ours was the first neck they cut.

lines: Phir bhi kehte hain mujhse ye ahl-e-chaman

lines: Ye chaman hai hamara, tumhara nahin

lines: Zaalimo, apni qismat pe naazaan na ho
couplets.en: You who deal so cruelly, take no pride in your fortune.

lines: Daur badlega, ye waqt ki baat hai
couplets.en: In time, the tide will turn.
